description: Expander for the Hyper Maniacal LFO, placed immediately to the right of it, breaking out all four waveforms of each of that module's six oscillators

outputs.text: The sine wave of that oscillator, -5V to 5V, present whatever the wave switch on the Hyper Maniacal LFO is set to
The saw wave of that oscillator, -5V to 5V, present whatever the wave switch on the Hyper Maniacal LFO is set to
The triangle wave of that oscillator, -5V to 5V, present whatever the wave switch on the Hyper Maniacal LFO is set to
The square wave of that oscillator, -5V to 5V, present whatever the wave switch on the Hyper Maniacal LFO is set to

menu: Offset mode — sets these outputs Bipolar or Unipolar, or Follow LFO, which takes the polarity from the output switch on the Hyper Maniacal LFO
